title.zh: 将东米萨米斯省Balingasag市镇Balingasag医疗社区医院床位由15张增至25张并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Balingasag Medicare Community Hospital in the Municipality of Balingasag, Province of Misamis Oriental, From Fifteen (15) to Twenty-five (25) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Balingasag Medicare Community Hospital in the Municipality of Balingasag, Province of Misamis Oriental, From Fifteen (15) to Twenty-five (25) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: The bed capacity of the Balingasag Medicare Community Hospital in the Municipality of Balingasag, Province of Misamis Oriental, is hereby increased from fifteen (15) to twenty-five (25) beds.

The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be charged against the lump-sum appropriations authorized for the purpose under the current General Appropriations Act. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the hospital shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
